description.value: At 5th level, the gambler learns to gamble with fate, compelling an enemy to risk their fortune. As an immediate action, the gambler can target a creature within 30 feet that has successfully made a saving throw against an effect from the gambler or one of his allies, forcing a second saving throw at the same DC. If the second roll fails, the creature suffers the full effects. If it succeeds again, the gambler suffers the effect instead. A gambler can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + his Charisma modifier.
